build_embedder: build an embedder model by name (vae, unet, hidden, patchmixer, dvmark) with config and number of bits
create_vae_embedder: create a VAE embedder with a VAEEncoder, VAEDecoder, and MsgProcessor for watermark insertion
create_unet_embedder: create a UNet embedder with a UNetMsg backbone and MsgProcessor for watermark insertion
create_hidden_embedder: create a hidden embedder with a HiddenEncoder for watermark insertion
create_dvmark_embedder: create a DVMark embedder with a DVMarkEncoder for watermark insertion
